instruction: Enclosure Compatibility with Hammond 1455 The file board.kicad_pcb is a 150x100 mm board with several placed components. The file /home/user/Desktop/enclosure.yaml specifies the Hammond 1455C1201 internal PCB slot dimensions and keep-in clearance. Shrink the board outline to fit within the enclosure slot dimensions. Reposition any component whose center is within the keep-in distance of the new board edge. Requirements: 1. Board width <= internal_slot_w_mm (from /home/user/Desktop/enclosure.yaml). 2. Board height <= internal_slot_h_mm (from /home/user/Desktop/enclosure.yaml). 3. Every component center is >= edge_keep_in_mm from all board edges. 4. All original component references (U1, U2, R1, R2) must still be present. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.

command: import pyautogui; import time; RATIO_X = 0.589; RATIO_Y = 0.726; time.sleep(5); screen_w, screen_h = pyautogui.size(); x = int(screen_w * RATIO_X); y = int(screen_h * RATIO_Y); pyautogui.click(x, y); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click(x, y); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click(x, y)
